stem: The work order calls for selective lower-canopy cleanup, but a coworker suggests heavy whole-plant defoliation. What should Technician I do?
choices: Follow the authorized lower-canopy cleanup work order and route any requested scope change for approval rather than expanding the task independently.
Use the coworker's heavier defoliation method if it appears more efficient and still leaves the plants healthy.
Remove extra tissue so all plants look uniform even if the work order did not call for that intensity.
Ignore the work order if the coworker has more canopy experience.
rationale: The technician's authority comes from the current controlled work order, not coworker preference. A heavier whole-plant defoliation changes the scope and intensity of the task and may affect crop response. Technician I should complete the authorized work and escalate any proposed change rather than silently expanding the treatment.
